summary: The targeted refinement achieved superior standalone image quality but at the cost of complete concept/identity drift. Every dimension of the target character (age, identity, style, wardrobe, fantasy direction) was lost. The refinement package lacked sufficient constraints to prevent the model from defaulting to a realistic elderly portrait, likely because the prompt refinements for 'texture' and 'detail' pushed the generation toward photorealism at the expense of fantasy character fidelity.
